definitions.explanation: A small jumping insect that feeds on rice plants by sucking their sap, one of the most damaging pests of rice paddies. Large outbreaks can wither whole fields.

examples.japanese: ウンカ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{被害|ひがい}→被害：02572_higai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{収穫|しゅうかく}→収穫：03207_shuukaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{減|へ}った→減る：01985_heru⟧。
examples.english: The harvest fell because of planthopper damage.

examples.japanese: ウンカ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大量|たいりょう}→大量：03112_tairyou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{発生|はっせい}する→発生する：25529_hasseisuru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{稲|いね}→稲：01820_ine⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{枯|か}れて→枯れる：04589_kareru⟧⟦{田|た}んぼ→田んぼ：00402_tanbo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{茶色|ちゃいろ}く→茶色い：00922_chairoi⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: When planthoppers break out in large numbers, the rice can wither and turn the paddy brown.

notes:
Usually written in katakana. A major rice pest; some species migrate to Japan on seasonal winds from the Asian mainland.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ウンカ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{発生|はっせい}→発生：03133_hassei⟧: an outbreak of planthoppers
- ウンカ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{被害|ひがい}→被害：02572_higai⟧: planthopper damage

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{害虫|がいちゅう}→害虫：06430_gaichuu⟧: pest — the general term; ウンカ is a specific rice pest
